opus.problem: Gives the word away. A wedding Jesus attended with His mother and disciples in a Galilee town is the single best-known fact about Cana. It adds no fact the other wedding clues lack, so it is not medium hard.

Not fully true to its cited verse. John 21:2 only says these disciples were together. The fishing is in John 21:3 and the Sea of Tiberias is in John 21:1, so the reference does not support those details.
